reviews.review: Great fun with friends, excellent that they continue to update. It's a much more complete game now than it was at launch!!
This game is awesome. Constant dev updates. Nice job Ghost Ship!

Great devs; no ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, road map is stuck too with monthly updates the vast majority of the time.
One of few co-op games where if you play with randoms, it feels like you're actually cooperating.
60 hours and not bored of shouting ROCK AND STONE every time something at least average happens.

It feels like it's been awhile since I played a good roguelike shooter. The days of Super Hexagon and Timespinner and Blockhogge are well behind me and my current go-to favorite comes from the indie space: Subnautica. I remember the days of capturing/racing giant sharks in that game, although with the addition of Minecraft-esque tools like pickaxes and a hatchet, they can now be fun instead of terrifying.

My main problem with the game was a graphics glitch I found in the latest build, where the game ran way too fast at one point. When I tried to slow down the graphics, the game crashed. So I'll keep an eye out for that until I get the game up and running well on my phone.
